metadata.merge_note: Merged claude_style_experiences general experiences, task-specific experiences, and common mistakes into state-aware experience schema.

old_bank_metadata.source: generated from ALFWorld trajectories using o3

metadata.validation_analysis_note: Pruned and revised using 128 validation trajectories at global_step 190; emphasized exact admissible actions, move-to-receptacle syntax, loop recovery, and post-state-change delivery.

experiences.trigger: the model is about to output an action after reasoning
experiences.recommended_action: copy one exact string from the current admissible actions list into the action tag
experiences.avoid_action: emit free-form explanation, omit the action tag, or invent a shortened action string
experiences.expected_effect: the environment accepts the action instead of returning an invalid parse or Nothing happens
experiences.retrieval_text: exact admissible action string action tag avoid parse failure nothing happens

experiences.trigger: the last observation says Nothing happens after a go/open/examine/take action
experiences.recommended_action: treat the previous action as unproductive and choose a different admissible action that changes location, opens a new container, takes a visible target, or completes the next subgoal
experiences.avoid_action: repeat the same action or keep examining the same object without new state
experiences.expected_effect: the agent escapes loops that consumed many failed validation episodes
state_cues: no new object or state observed
experiences.retrieval_text: nothing happens do not repeat same action choose new admissible action loop recovery

experiences.trigger: current observation shows a closed plausible container and the target is not yet found
experiences.recommended_action: open the closed container once, then inspect or move on according to the contents
experiences.avoid_action: assume the closed container is empty or repeatedly open an already-open container
experiences.expected_effect: the container contents become visible or the location is ruled out without looping
experiences.retrieval_text: closed container target missing open once inspect contents avoid repeated open

experiences.trigger: a visible object exactly matches the target object type and a take action is admissible
experiences.recommended_action: take the exact visible target object immediately
experiences.avoid_action: take a look-alike or unrelated object, or leave the target behind to search elsewhere
experiences.expected_effect: the target becomes held and the next subgoal can be transformation or delivery
experiences.retrieval_text: visible exact target take immediately avoid wrong object leave behind

experiences.trigger: inventory is holding a goal object and the destination receptacle is reachable or visible
experiences.recommended_action: navigate to the destination if needed, then use the admissible move <object> to <receptacle> action
experiences.avoid_action: say put/drop/place when the environment only admits move, or continue searching while holding the object
experiences.expected_effect: the held object is placed in the required receptacle using the environment's actual action format
experiences.retrieval_text: holding target destination visible use move object to receptacle not put

experiences.trigger: the task requires two or more instances of the same target object
experiences.recommended_action: after each successful move to the destination, decrement the remaining count and search only for the missing instances
experiences.avoid_action: move the same instance repeatedly, stop after one item, or keep searching after the required count is complete
experiences.expected_effect: multi-object tasks progress by object count instead of repeated redundant moves
state_cues: same object still visible at destination
experiences.retrieval_text: multi instance count moved objects remaining count avoid moving same object repeatedly

experiences.trigger: a required object has already been moved to the goal receptacle and appears there in later observations
experiences.recommended_action: count that object as completed and do not take it back out unless the task state must be corrected
experiences.avoid_action: retrieve the completed object from the destination and redo the same subgoal
experiences.expected_effect: the agent preserves achieved progress and uses remaining steps for unmet objects or states
state_cues: tempted to take object from destination
experiences.retrieval_text: object already at destination count as completed do not take back out

experiences.trigger: the agent has examined or visited the same location several times with no new contents
experiences.recommended_action: mark that location as searched and switch to an unvisited surface or unopened container
experiences.avoid_action: keep using examine/go on the same location after identical observations
experiences.expected_effect: search coverage expands instead of stalling at the 50-step limit
experiences.retrieval_text: repeated examine identical observation mark searched move to unvisited location

experiences.trigger: the goal contains a state word such as clean, hot, or cool
experiences.recommended_action: parse it as a required object-state predicate and route to sinkbasin, microwave, or fridge before final move
experiences.avoid_action: treat hot/cool/clean as ordinary pick-and-place and move the object before transformation
experiences.expected_effect: state-changing tasks satisfy the property predicate before final placement
experiences.retrieval_text: state word clean hot cool requires sinkbasin microwave fridge before final move

experiences.trigger: target object is visible on a surface or inside an opened container
experiences.recommended_action: take the target, then deliver it with move <object> to <destination> once the destination is reached
experiences.avoid_action: inspect unrelated objects after seeing the target or use a non-admissible put command
experiences.expected_effect: simple placement tasks complete in the shortest target-acquire-deliver sequence
experiences.retrieval_text: pick and place visible target take then move to destination

experiences.trigger: the desired object is commonly found in receptacles or furniture near the current room context
experiences.recommended_action: search plausible surfaces first, then unopened containers; after each empty observation choose a new candidate
experiences.avoid_action: bounce between the same two surfaces or repeatedly examine empty furniture
experiences.expected_effect: the agent finds hidden or less obvious targets without wasting the full episode
experiences.retrieval_text: pick and place systematic search plausible surfaces unopened containers no bounce loop

experiences.trigger: the destination is itself a container such as drawer, cabinet, microwave, or fridge
experiences.recommended_action: open the destination if needed, then move the held object to it when the move action appears
experiences.avoid_action: stand at a closed destination and repeatedly examine/open after the object is already ready
experiences.expected_effect: the destination becomes able to receive the object and placement succeeds
experiences.retrieval_text: destination container open then move held object drawer cabinet microwave fridge

experiences.trigger: an object with the same type is already present at the destination before pickup
experiences.recommended_action: use it as progress evidence only if it satisfies the target count; otherwise search for additional instances
experiences.avoid_action: ignore already placed matching objects or move them away from the destination
experiences.expected_effect: multi-object goals avoid unnecessary removal and count existing valid placements correctly
experiences.retrieval_text: matching object already at destination count progress search additional instances

experiences.trigger: holding the exact object that must be cleaned and a sinkbasin is reachable
experiences.recommended_action: go to the sinkbasin and execute clean <object> with sinkbasin exactly once when admissible
experiences.avoid_action: clean a different held object or keep examining the sinkbasin after the exact target is available
experiences.expected_effect: the target receives the clean state before delivery
experiences.retrieval_text: clean exact held target with sinkbasin once before delivery

experiences.trigger: the observation confirms You clean the target using the sinkbasin
experiences.recommended_action: navigate directly to the destination and move the cleaned object there
experiences.avoid_action: repeat cleaning, switch to another object, or cool/heat the object by mistake
experiences.expected_effect: the already-clean object is delivered instead of losing progress in state loops
state_cues: You clean the object using sinkbasin
experiences.retrieval_text: after clean confirmation go destination move object avoid repeat clean wrong appliance

experiences.trigger: the model is holding an object whose type differs from the clean-task target
experiences.recommended_action: drop or ignore the wrong object and resume searching for the exact named target
experiences.avoid_action: clean the wrong object just because a clean action is available
experiences.expected_effect: the state change is applied to the object named in the goal, not to a distractor
experiences.retrieval_text: clean task wrong held object do not clean distractor exact target only

experiences.trigger: holding the exact object that must become hot and a microwave is reachable
experiences.recommended_action: go to the microwave, open it if needed, then execute heat <object> with microwave when admissible
experiences.avoid_action: heat a distractor object or go to the final receptacle before heating the target
experiences.expected_effect: the target obtains the heated state before final placement
experiences.retrieval_text: hot heat exact held target with microwave before final move

experiences.trigger: the observation confirms You heat the target using the microwave
experiences.recommended_action: go directly to the destination and move the heated target there
experiences.avoid_action: return to the microwave, search unrelated surfaces, or heat another object
experiences.expected_effect: the heated object is delivered while the state predicate is fresh and progress is preserved
state_cues: You heat the object using microwave
experiences.retrieval_text: after heat confirmation direct destination move heated target no detour

experiences.trigger: a microwave or final receptacle is visible but the exact target object is not held
experiences.recommended_action: search for and take the exact target before using the microwave or destination
experiences.avoid_action: interact with appliances first or substitute another object of a different type
experiences.expected_effect: the heating sequence starts only after the correct target is controlled
experiences.retrieval_text: hot task exact target first no appliance before object no substitute

experiences.trigger: holding the exact object that must become cool and a fridge is reachable
experiences.recommended_action: go to the fridge, open it if needed, then execute cool <object> with fridge when admissible
experiences.avoid_action: move the object to the final receptacle before cooling or repeatedly go to the fridge without cooling
experiences.expected_effect: the target receives the cooled state and is ready for final delivery
experiences.retrieval_text: cool exact held target with fridge before final move avoid fridge loop

experiences.trigger: the observation confirms You cool the target using the fridge
experiences.recommended_action: navigate directly to the destination and use move <object> to <destination>
experiences.avoid_action: cool the same object again, take it back from the destination, or return to the fridge after successful cooling
experiences.expected_effect: the cooled object is delivered without entering the repeated fridge loop seen in failed validation episodes
state_cues: You cool the object using fridge
experiences.retrieval_text: after cool confirmation direct destination move cooled target no repeat fridge

experiences.trigger: the target object is visible inside or near the fridge during a cool task
experiences.recommended_action: use the exact admissible take <object> from <source> action, then still execute cool <object> with fridge if the goal is unmet
experiences.avoid_action: invent actions like take cool object from fridge or assume fridge location alone completes cooling
experiences.expected_effect: the object is controlled with a valid action and receives explicit cooling before placement
state_cues: target in fridge or near fridge
experiences.retrieval_text: cool task take exact object not take cool object explicit cool with fridge

experiences.trigger: the agent repeatedly goes to fridge, opens fridge, or examines fridge while not holding the target
experiences.recommended_action: leave the fridge area and search unvisited likely source locations for the exact target object
experiences.avoid_action: stay at the fridge expecting the target to appear after repeated open/examine/go actions
experiences.expected_effect: the agent escapes fridge fixation and resumes object acquisition
experiences.retrieval_text: cool task repeated fridge actions target missing leave fridge search surfaces

experiences.trigger: the cooled object has already been moved to the destination and the reward is not yet complete because another condition remains
experiences.recommended_action: do not retrieve that cooled object; update progress and solve the remaining object or count condition
experiences.avoid_action: take the cooled object back to the fridge and repeat cooling
experiences.expected_effect: completed cooled placements are preserved while remaining subgoals are handled
experiences.retrieval_text: cooled object already destination preserve progress do not take back repeat cooling

experiences.trigger: the task is look at target under the desklamp and a desklamp is visible or known
experiences.recommended_action: go to the desklamp location and use the exact admissible lamp action, commonly use desklamp 1
experiences.avoid_action: repeatedly examine the target or desk while the lamp has not been used
experiences.expected_effect: the light condition becomes active so the look/examine goal can complete
experiences.retrieval_text: look at under desklamp use exact desklamp action before repeated examine

experiences.trigger: the target object is visible but not at the desklamp location
experiences.recommended_action: take the target, go to the desk/desklamp area, and use an admissible look/use action involving the target and desklamp
experiences.avoid_action: wander away after seeing the target or examine unrelated objects near the lamp
experiences.expected_effect: the target and light source are brought together for the required relation
experiences.retrieval_text: visible target take carry to desklamp look use action

experiences.trigger: an admissible action explicitly says look at <target> under desklamp or under the desklamp
experiences.recommended_action: select that exact action string before trying generic examine commands
experiences.avoid_action: shorten it to look at target, use under desk, or omit the object instance number
experiences.expected_effect: the environment receives the relation-specific action it can score
experiences.retrieval_text: exact look at target under desklamp admissible action no shortened action

experiences.trigger: the agent has examined the same cd/keychain/laptop/desk several times with Nothing happens
experiences.recommended_action: switch to using the desklamp, taking the target, or moving to a new candidate desk/shelf location
experiences.avoid_action: continue generic examine actions after identical no-progress feedback
experiences.expected_effect: look-at failures recover from examine loops before reaching the step limit
experiences.retrieval_text: look task repeated examine nothing happens switch use desklamp take target new location

experiences.trigger: there are multiple desks, shelves, or candidate target instances
experiences.recommended_action: track which target instance and desklamp location have been tried; after a failed pairing, try a new untested instance-location pair
experiences.avoid_action: repeat the same target-desk pairing after it produced no progress
experiences.expected_effect: the agent searches alternative valid pairings instead of looping on one cd or desk
experiences.retrieval_text: multiple desklamp target instances track tried pairs switch after failed pairing
